faultLoc.explanation: The method `replacePattern` does not handle the case where `source` or `regex` is `null`. When either of these parameters is `null`, the `Pattern.compile` or `matcher` method will throw a `NullPointerException`. Adding null checks for these parameters before using them will prevent the exception.

The method `removePattern` calls `replacePattern` without checking if `source` or `regex` is `null`. This leads to the same `NullPointerException` in `replacePattern`. Adding null checks in `removePattern` before calling `replacePattern` will prevent the exception.
